checks.name: environment_declared
checks.remediation: Set ENVIRONMENT explicitly for non-local deployments.

checks.name: demo_auth_disabled_outside_development
checks.evidence: Demo credentials must not be enabled in staging/production.
checks.remediation: Use real authentication or keep ENVIRONMENT=development for demos.

checks.name: database_url_configured
checks.evidence: DATABASE_URL is required outside local development.
checks.remediation: Set DATABASE_URL to Postgres for deployment-shaped runs.

checks.name: cors_origin_explicit_for_non_dev
checks.evidence: ONCOTRACK_CORS_ORIGINS should list exact frontend origins outside local demos.

checks.name: no_placeholder_llm_key_for_remote_mode
checks.evidence: GROQ_API_KEY appears unset or placeholder; deterministic/local paths may still work.
checks.remediation: Set a real key for live API RAG demos, or document deterministic-only mode.

checks.name: frontend_production_dockerfile_present
checks.remediation: Add frontend-react/Dockerfile for static Vite serving.

checks.name: prod_compose_present
checks.remediation: Add docker-compose.prod.yml for non-dev container smoke testing.

checks.name: production_boundary_artifact_present
checks.evidence: Production boundary artifact exists and blocks healthcare-production claims.

allowed_claim: Deployment-shaped engineering prototype with preflight checks, health/readiness probes, Docker assets, and explicit boundaries.
claim_boundary: Deployment readiness here covers software packaging and environment hygiene only. It does not establish clinical validation, PHI compliance, hospital readiness, or real-world safety.
